subject: Recon: VAT timing difference and unapplied payment on INV-2231
messages:
From: Accounts Payable - Acme Enterprises <ap-contact@acme-enterprises.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T09:12:00Z
Subject: Query: VAT on INV-2231 (March) - payment applied mismatch

Hi Vivek,

We pulled our March remittance and the payment allocated to INV-2231 looks lower on our side by 1,500 EUR compared to the amount posted to your ledger. Can you confirm the VAT amount used when you recognized revenue for this invoice? Our payment file is attached (payment_ledger_extract.csv).

Attachment: payment_ledger_extract.csv (CSV, 12KB)

Thanks,
--
Clara Mendes
Accounts Payable
Acme Enterprises
ap-contact@acme-enterprises.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T11:03:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Query: VAT on INV-2231 (March) - payment applied mismatch

Folks — forwarding an AP query from Acme. Quick summary: Acme's remittance shows a net payment that is 1,500 EUR less than what we have applied on INV-2231. They suspect a VAT timing/rounding difference.

What I need:
- Can tax confirm whether the VAT we accrued for INV-2231 (recognized in March revenue close) used the 21% rate or a zero-rated adjustment?
- Finance: if we did accrue VAT at a different rate or timing, we'll need a journal correction to align the arrears and mark the unapplied portion to suspense until resolution.

Attachments: INV-2231.pdf (Invoice, 48KB), payment_ledger_extract.csv (forwarded)

Proposed immediate action: prepare a provisional VAT accrual reversal journal for April close and hold unapplied cash in a suspense clearing account until Acme confirms. Marcus, can you draft the JE? Lauren, please advise on revenue recognition mapping impact. Naomi, looping you for tax input.

Thanks,
Vivek
Director, Finance Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T13:27:00Z
Subject: RE: Fwd: Query: VAT on INV-2231 (March) - payment applied mismatch

Vivek/Team —

I pulled the invoice and the March close pack. Preliminary notes:
- INV-2231 gross = 8,281.00 EUR, VAT recorded at 21% = 1,437.00 EUR, net = 6,844.00 EUR.
- Acme's payment file shows a net of 6, - (they have 6, -) there is a rounding/format issue in their CSV where the decimal got dropped; Clara's CSV shows 6,844.00 but the remittance sum is 5,344.00 (1,500 difference).

Possible causes:
1) Bank application error on their side (most likely)
2) Our VAT accrual used an override (one-off zero-rate) for a promotional service line (I will check the invoice lines)

I attached a draft journal template for a provisional clearing JE that moves 1,500 EUR from Accounts Receivable to Suspense - VAT timing, pending confirmation. If tax confirms we need to adjust revenue mapping, we'll post the revenue reversal + corrected VAT entry in May close.

Attachment: vat_accrual_journal_draft.xlsx (XLSX, 24KB)

I'll hold off posting until we hear back from Acme, but want to get the template ready so month-end isn't blocked.

- Marcus
Senior Accounting Manager
From: Accounts Payable - Acme Enterprises <ap-contact@acme-enterprises.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-11T08:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Query: VAT on INV-2231 (March) - payment applied mismatch

Hi Vivek / Marcus,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. I dug into our payments team output — there was a file export script that removed decimals from amounts for a set of legacy customers (we're fixing it). The true payment amount for INV-2231 is 6,844.00 EUR and the difference is our export error. We will reissue an updated remittance with corrected amounts and notify our bank to reapply the unapplied funds.

For audit purposes, can you provide the provisional journal template you mentioned (suspense move) so we can confirm the final reconciled position once the bank reposts?

Clara
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Clara Mendes <ap-contact@acme-enterprises.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-11T10:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Query: VAT on INV-2231 (March) - payment applied mismatch

Clara — thanks for the update and for escalating to your payments team. Appreciate the quick root-cause.

We're attaching the provisional JE template (vat_accrual_journal_draft.xlsx) for your records — it moves the 1,500 EUR from AR (INV-2231) into AR-Suspense:VAT-timing (GL 2105 -> 3009) with a memo referencing Acme remittance correction. Once your bank confirms the repost, we'll reverse the suspense entry and apply the cash to the invoice. If tax flags a revenue mapping issue, we'll include the revenue reversal in May close and share the documentation.

Attachment: vat_accrual_journal_draft.xlsx (XLSX, 24KB)

Next steps we agreed internally:
- Acme to send corrected remittance and bank notice (Clara).
- Marcus to prepare provisional JE for April close as suspense move but hold posting until bank confirms.
- Naomi to confirm tax treatment (does the accrual require a formal reversal or just suspense hold).
- Vivek to sign off on final JE before posting.

Regards,
Vivek
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Clara Mendes <ap-contact@acme-enterprises.com>
Date: 2027-05-12T14:23:00Z
Subject: RE: Query: VAT on INV-2231 (March) - payment applied mismatch

Vivek/All —

Confirming I reviewed the revenue mapping and there is no promo line or override on INV-2231; VAT at 21% was applied correctly in March. Naomi, please confirm tax approach but from a revenue perspective we do not need a revenue reversal if cash is reapplied to the original invoice. Marcus, please proceed to prepare the JE as drafted but do not post until we receive bank confirmation from Acme.

I'm attaching the signed JE approval (journal_entry_signed.pdf) for your QA queue — once Acme confirms and we have bank trace, Marcus will post the reversal of the suspense move and then apply cash.

Attachment: journal_entry_signed.pdf (PDF, 8KB)

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Revenue Accounting
